items.task: Refresh onboarding screen copy in the mobile app
items.summary: Rewrote the welcome carousel headlines and fixed two typos in the signup screen.

items.task: Build the Stripe webhook handler for invoice payments
items.summary: Some invoice payments are applied twice because Stripe resends the webhook while the handler is still retrying.
blockers: Stripe resends the webhook after a 10 second timeout and the handler processes the charge twice

items.task: Migrate auth sessions to signed cookies
items.summary: Login works locally but staging SSO rejects the callback with the new cookie.
blockers: Staging SSO callback rejects the new cookie domain

items.task: Rewrite billing retry logic with exponential backoff
items.summary: Backoff with jitter is in place; moving the max-attempts setting out of dunning_config into retry.ts constants, so the retry helper signature changes.
Stripe resent webhooks that took too long, so some charges were processed twice. The handler now acknowledges immediately and a queue does the work.
Removed dead code paths from the retry worker and documented the schedule.
Invoice numbers are sequential per legal entity.
Support can issue credit notes that reverse ledger entries.
Invoices show tax per line item from the tax service.
Retry worker emits attempt and success counters for the ops dashboard.
Payment capture uses optimistic version checks on the invoice row.
Nightly CSV export of invoices and payments for finance.
The retry worker reads max_attempts from the dunning_config table.
Customers get dunning emails after failed retries, linked to the payment update page.
Proration is computed server-side in integer cents; invoice totals match the ledger again.
Upgrades and downgrades mid-cycle now prorate on the next invoice.
Finalized invoices now write a ledger entry through the ledger client.
Invoices render to PDF on finalize and are attached to the receipt email.
Moved failed-charge retries to an increasing schedule after the fixed cron caused merchant blocks.

items.task: Set up the billing retry worker
items.summary: Added a worker that retries failed card charges automatically.
